findings: Category editor only disables Save for a blank category name; destination folder can be blank or contain path components. This makes the previously reviewed missing folder containment validation reachable through ordinary UI, not just imported JSON.

Extensions/keywords/examples use unescaped comma-join/split in the editor. A filename example containing commas is split into multiple entries on saving even if the user did not intend to edit examples.

Settings classification mode is disabled while working, but category import/edit/toggle/remove and age/confidence changes remain enabled. They can alter current plan and scan state while async work is suspended.
Teach sheet disables Save only for Needs Review, not busy state; it dismisses after awaited state.teach even when that handler records a save error, without returning success/failure to the sheet.
ConfidenceView renders raw percentage as width without clamping to 0...100; imported profile confidence has no reviewed range enforcement. Ordinary editor Stepper bounds its own value.
QuickLook preview autostarts and displays URL content via system preview, without explicit teardown in this wrapper. Actual preview behavior and resource use were not executed.
Complete Views.swift now read across three sequential ranges, without claiming rendered UI or complete app qualification.
